# Data Source: tfe_provider_set

Gets a provider set by name.

~> **Warning:** This data source is currently in beta and isn't generally available to all users. It is subject to change or be removed.

## Example Usage

```csharp
using Constructs;
using HashiCorp.Cdktf;
/*Provider bindings are generated by running cdktf get.
See https://cdk.tf/provider-generation for more details.*/
using Gen.Providers.Tfe;
class MyConvertedCode : TerraformStack
{
    public MyConvertedCode(Construct scope, string name) : base(scope, name)
    {
        new DataTfeProviderSet.DataTfeProviderSet(this, "my_provider_set", new DataTfeProviderSetConfig {
            Name = "example-provider-set",
            Organization = "example-org"
        });
    }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `Name` (String) The name of the provider set.

### Optional

- `Organization` (String) Name of the organization. If omitted, organization must be defined in the provider config.

### Read-Only

- `Description` (String) The description of the provider set.
- `Global` (Boolean) Whether the provider set applies globally.
- `Id` (String) The ID of the provider set.
- `Priority` (Boolean) Whether the provider set takes priority over provider sets with more specific scopes.
- `ProjectIds` (Set of String) The IDs of the projects attached to the provider set.
- `ProviderSource` (String) Source address of the provider, e.g. `RegistryTerraformIo/hashicorp/tfe`.
- `WorkspaceIds` (Set of String) The IDs of the workspaces attached to the provider set.
